input.quote: Upon termination or expiration of this Agreement, each party shall otherwise return or destroy any Confidential Information of the other party provided, however, Corio may retain any Confidential Information necessary for Corio to continue supporting it's then-existing Customers.
input.rationale: Section 11.3 handles the continuity limb of the rule well in our favour (our right to keep serving existing Customers survives, and Commerce One's support and maintenance obligation survives indefinitely so long as we keep paying), and Section 12's source code escrow further protects continuity. However, no provision anywhere requires Commerce One to return or export our and our Customers' data (including data held in or generated by the MarketSite.net Service) in a machine-readable format, or to delete and certify deletion thereafter; Section 11.3 only addresses Confidential Information on a "return or destroy" basis at the holder's election, with no format or timing. The data-export limb is a material term of the fallback (data export within 30 days), so the clause fails the fallback and we have inserted a new Section 11.4 reflecting the preferred position (six months' assistance at then-current rates, 30-day machine-readable return, certified deletion), noting we can accept 90 days of assistance.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance, data return and deletion certification obligations in Section 11.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 11.3 preserves continuity of support for our existing Customers but says nothing about getting our and our Customers' data back from Commerce One (including data held in the MarketSite.net Service). We have added our standard exit provision: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return of data within 30 days in a machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter. We can live with 90 days of assistance if that is easier.

ops.text: 11.4 Transition Assistance and Data Return. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Commerce One shall (i) at Corio's request, provide reasonable transition assistance to Corio and its Customers for a period of up to six (6) months at Commerce One's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of Corio's request, return or export to Corio all data of Corio, its Customers and Software Users then in Commerce One's possession or control, including any such data residing in or generated by the MarketSite.net Service, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Corio in writing. This Section 11.4 shall survive any termination or expiration of this Agreement.
